canonical_title: Armament and store operation and delivery procedures

versions.title_at_revision: Armament and store operation and delivery procedures
versions.text:
Standard: Procedures for armament and stores operation and weapon delivery are defined, have been verified, and prevent unsafe operations, employment, or release/delivery. This includes functional and emergency procedures for the fire control systems, necessary pre-launch and post-launch support, all available safe ripple release intervals, salvo tables, safe escape tables and safe release envelopes, surface danger zones, masking profiles and exclusion zones, and emergency and combat jettison procedures. This also includes any flight manuals, operating procedures, and electronic tools that dictate the safe operation, employment, and release of stores that enable in-flight weaponeering. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Verify that technical data contains store operating and delivery procedures.
(2) Verify technical data contains all operating procedures, warnings, cautions, notes, and limitations.
(3) Technical data contains employment limitations including safe escape, salvo, surface danger, and exclusion zones. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Examination.
(4) Verify that applicable store operating and delivery procedures have been validated and verified by the appropriate technical authority and are documented in USG verified technical documents or equivalent supplement(s).
(5) Verify that all electronic tools supporting store operating and delivery procedures are verified and comply with the USG verified technical documents.
